instruction: A candid outdoor full shot captures three friends conversing on a grassy park field. On the left, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands with his arms crossed, looking to the right. In the center, the large Black man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) stands looking right and speaking. On the right, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) stands leaning slightly forward, resting her hand on the arm of the large Black man (R1) while looking at him. The three stand close together in a relaxed manner under bright daylight, with soft shadows on the green grass.
elements: R4 rests her hand on R1's arm
R1 is the person whose arm is being touched by R4
R1 is speaking while R4 looks at him
R2 stands nearby with his arms crossed rather than making contact
R4 leans slightly forward toward R1
The interaction takes place on a grassy outdoor park field
